title: Acne candidate verifier v2: TRAIN label review + flat-skin negative coverage, one refit (fixed before review)
keeps: v1 model docs/acne-verifier-model-20261016.json (sha b6fa6c05...), its calibration, labels and DEV results are kept unchanged and not renamed.
data: TRAIN only: the 158 manifest-v6 photos with replay rows, their cached Step0 final candidates and frozen 1920-d features (audit-results/acne-verifier/train). DEV, DEV Clear, the 108-target scope and the sealed test are not used for selection, review, training or calibration. DEV false points are not converted into training data.
fixed: Step0 weights, candidate generation (conf .30, NMS .30, product masks, old box filter), feature extraction acne-candidate-verifier-features-v1. No new model, architecture, feature, filter, point merge or hyperparameter search.

pools.neg: all 71 v1 negatives (6 clean ROI, 65 confounder box)
pools.unl: 169 from the 1209 v1 'excluded: unlabelled area' candidates

reviewList.diversity: strata pose (FRONT / side) x face-width tertile; per-photo caps pos 2, unl 4; deterministic sha256 ordering with seed 20261016
reviewList.blind: review sheets show only the review id, a tight crop, a near-context crop and a face-context view with a marker; not the pool, the v1 label, source boxes or the detector score. The list is committed before any sheet is looked at; no item is replaced after review.

reviewCategories.A: visible acne-like lesion at the marker (papule/pustule/comedone-like raised or inflamed spot)
reviewCategories.F: clearly flat/clean skin at the marker: a false candidate on plain skin
reviewCategories.M: other element: mole / pigment / freckle / post-lesion mark or scar (ben-leke)
reviewCategories.P: other element: pore / skin texture / shine or specular highlight (gozenek-parlama)
reviewCategories.O: other element: hair, eyebrow, lip, nostril, eye, shadow edge, jewellery or anything else (diger)
reviewCategories.U: uncertain (resolution, blur, ambiguous): excluded from learning and calibration
reviewCategories.reviewLevel: AI engineering review on crops, not expert/dermatologist verification. Decisions are a separate layer (audit-results/acne-verifier-v2/review-decisions.json); manifest and v1 labels are not modified.

labelsV2.reviewed: A -> positive; F, M, P, O -> negative with type flat / mole-mark / pore-shine / other; U -> excluded
labelsV2.unreviewed: v1 positives not in the review list stay positive (their reliability is estimated by the 60-control confirmation rate and reported); all other unreviewed candidates stay excluded (no unreviewed negatives remain, as all 71 v1 negatives are reviewed)

split.groups: v1 groups (photo, dHash <= 10 near-duplicate clusters merged); all candidates of a group in one split
split.rule: groups that contain >= 1 flat (F) negative are ordered by sha256(20261016|v2split|group) and the first round(0.3 n) (at least 2) go to calibration, the rest to learn; all other groups are ordered the same way and split 70/30 learn/calibration
split.minimum: at least 2 different photos with flat negatives in learn AND in calibration; otherwise report the counts and the missing category and stop without fitting (no budget increase)

model: LogisticRegression L2, C = 0.1, class_weight balanced, lbfgs, max_iter 2000 on z-scored features; standardiser fitted on learn only; one fit
threshold: highest threshold keeping >= 95% of calibration positives (same rule as v1)
calibrationReport: overall AUC and per negative type (flat / mole-mark / pore-shine / other): n, AUC positive-vs-type, fraction removed at the threshold with Wilson 95% interval. A good overall AUC is not reported as flat-skin success.
gate: same as v1: calibration AUC >= 0.65 and >= 15% of calibration negatives removed; otherwise report and stop before DEV

dev.once: after freezing v2: A = Step0 + old filter, B = A + v1, C = A + v2 on the same 108 targets, layer 1, masks, r = 0.03 face width and one-to-one matching; 0a8a14a662a5 stays in scope with no special rule; no retraining or recalibration after DEV
dev.replaceRule: v2 becomes the preferred staging verifier only if C finds >= the targets of B AND has fewer false points than B; otherwise v1 stays preferred. Neither is enabled in the product (accepted:false, file:null).

licence: Training a classifier does not resolve rights questions on Step0 weights or the data sources; tracked separately.
